book.name: 1 Korin
book.title: Rau Tau Paulus Iboode Pa Yes Korin Imin Maata 1 Korin—1 Corinthians

content: Paulus ipalot yes Korin to tiuul zetazŋa tau tileep izi Yerusalem na

Aiyo, yau leg saveeŋ rig payam pa maet tau aghe agooga pa Krisi tamtamon tooni tau tileep izi Yerusalem na. Yau naghita eez tau naghuru pa lupuuŋ to Maaron tau tileep izi taan sirivu to Galesia na, yam ataghoni paam, o poia.

Saawe imin maata to wik tisov, na yam eŋaeŋa aat aghur maet tsiam siriv ila soghan itaghon uraat tsiam atuya. Leso ivot imin tiina ve isaŋan pa saawe to nalat. Ataghon aliŋag tane, o poia. Pa ighe nalat ve agooga soone, ene poia mako.

Ve aghur tamtamon tsiam siriv tau aghit zi aghe tirao, leso tigham maet tau agooga na ila pa toŋvetaz toit tau tileep izi Yerusalem. Saawe tau nalat, yau aat nabood rau siriv imin paesiiŋ pazi, leso tikis zi ve tila.
Ve isaav ighe naghita naghe poia to yau paam nala, ene aat yeŋa nila.
Paulus ipaesia laghooŋ tooni
Yau nagham ŋgar naghe nala naghita zetaanŋa siriv tau tileep irau taan sirivu to Masedonia. Tauvene yau aat nala naghit zi muuŋ. Le isov, o nalat naghit gham.

Ve naghe naleep tomani gham malau rig. Tauvene matag iŋgal naghe naleep tomani gham le saawe to nugh yauŋa isov, o yam irau aghit ghau pa laghooŋ tsiau, ve aghur ghau nala pa nugh sindei tau naghe nala pani.
Lolog pa nagig gham mon ve nala mako. Tauvene isaav ighe Maaron loolo tauvene, ene aat itiŋa taleep malau rig.
Eemon irau nala Masedonia rekia mako. Pale naleep izi nugh Epesus le irau lupuuŋ tiina to Pentekos ivot, o nala.
Pasaa, Maaron ikaak eez payau to nagham uraat tiina izi ta sene. Ve naghita naghe uraat tsiau ighurghur anooŋa. Eemon eval tiina tizorzoor saveeŋ tsiau paam.
Paulus ipaes pazi pa Timoti gha Apolos
Isaav ighe aghita Timoti ilat peria tsiam, na aghamu toman lolomim poia. Leso saawe tau ileep tomani gham na, iroi sov, ve loolo poia. Pa i ighamgham uraat to Tiina toit Krisi, raraate imin yau.
Tauvene tamtamon eta maata veleghini sov. Ve saawe tau i ipaburigin laghooŋ tooni muul na, yam auule, ve aghuru toman loolo poia, ve imuul ilam tsiau. Pa yau nasasaŋani tomania toŋvetaz toit siriv.
Ve toŋvetaz toit Apolos, saawe naol yau nasavsaav ariaaŋ pani naghe yesŋa toŋvetaz toit siriv tilat tighit gham. Eemon loolo pa ilat pa saawe tane mako. Pale ighita sooso eta, o ilat ighit gham.
Paulus iparwai saveeŋ tooni
Matamim imomoos poi, ve ayooz ariaaŋ pa ghuruuŋ ila tsiam. Aroi sov. Apariaaŋ taumim, ve ayooz tuŋia.
Ve saa ŋgar tau yam aghe aghamu, na aghamu itaghon ŋgar to loloon pa tamtamon.

Yam awatagh: Stepanas ve yes tau tileep tomania ila ruum tooni na, timuuŋ pa yam Akaia asov, ve tighur ila to Krisi imin maata. Ve yes tirei tauzi kat pa uraat to Tiina toit, ve tibesbees poi pa tamtamon tooni. Zeran tauvene, tomania tamtamon tisov tau tiuluul zi ve tipul tauzi kat pa uraat to Maaron na, naghe napalot gham to aleep ila sambazi, ve alooŋ aliŋazi.

Saawe tau Stepanas tomania Portunatus ve Akaikus tilam tivot tsiau, yes tigham ghau lolog poia kat. Onoon, yam eval irau alam mako. Eemon yes tigham naghomim gha tilam tivot sene, ve tiuul ghau pa gabua siriv.
Tauta tipalot ghau ve tigham ateg izi, imin monmon tighamgham payam na. Tamtamon tauvene, yam aat apakur zi.

Lupuuŋ tisov to Krisi tau tileep izi taan sirivu to Asia ne, tigham aaz poia toozi ilat payam. Akwila yesuru Prisila tomania yes tau tiluplup zi pa suŋuuŋ ila ruum toozi na, lolozi igheen tsiam kat. Tauvene yes paam tigham aaz poia toozi ilat payam ila Tiina toit eeza.
Ve toŋvetaz to Krisi tau yeŋa nilepleep ne paam, tisov tigham aaz poia toozi ilat payam. Yam asov toŋvetaz to Krisi. Tauvene lolomim poia pa taumim ve avataki nimamim.
Ene yau Paulus. Nabood aaz poia tane ilat payam pa taug nimag.
Isaav ighe tamtamon eta loolo pa Tiina toit mako, ene pale aatyavyav to Maaron izaa tooni. O Tiina tsiei, ulam lak!
Poia to Tiina toit Yesu igheen tomani gham.
Yau lolog igheen to yam asov. Pasaa, Yesu Krisi ilup ghiit ve taleep ila tooni.

footnotes.text: Paulus ibood ziiri tane ila yes Aramea aliŋazi. Isaav ighe: ‘Marana tha’.
